lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in semi-regular horizontal rows; density is higher in the anterior region posterior to the gills, transitioning to larger, more widely spaced clusters posteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with circular blobs to form a grid-like pattern, most visible in the mid-flank and ventral-lateral regions.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature running across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high-intensity highlights on the dorsal edge to deep shadows on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, faint, circular depigmented or blanched patch is visible on the upper-left section of the flank, posterior to the head/gill region.
other_distinctive_markers: Maze-like or vermiculated patterns of elevated pixel intensity connecting high-luminance blobs in the mid-to-posterior section of the visible flank.
